questions.question: Do ordinary !# instructions run before OnAfterErmInstructions in a new game?
questions.status: answered within identified normal new-game path
questions.answer: Yes. FindErm scans and executes immediate !# commands from all selected scripts while IsGameLoading0. The successful map-reader return invokes FindErm before the enclosing game initializer later reaches its PI hook. PI is trigger30370 and only fires when not loading.

questions.question: Is a successful ordinary !#PO:N2 visible to the first script42 weekly cycle?
questions.status: answered with explicit conditions, no original runtime probe
questions.answer: It must precede that source cycle. The PI stdlib resets lastTimerDay to-1; first ordinary OnEveryDay at game day1 computes weekday1 and onceTRUE; source42 then calls the mill/garden routine if171 is enabled. Its wheel/mill checks read any nonzero PO:N. Thus a successful !#PO:N2 remains eligible on the first cycle unless an intervening script/plugin overwrites or clears it. Script42 itself does not clear these markers in initialization or in the shown weekly routine; its N0 resets are commented out.

questions.question: Does loading rerun !#PO initialization or PI?
questions.status: answered for normal supplied ERA loader path, not every legacy/reload extension
questions.answer: Normal load sets IsGameLoading1. Supplied FindErm path skips ordinary initial instructions; PI wrapper also skips30370. ERA restores script/function state from saved sections and may recompile changed script arrays without replaying ordinary !# side effects. Exact restoration of each PO storage field was not re-audited here.

questions.question: What is the exact first native weekly reward-generation order?
questions.answer: The source42 weekly mutation is placed after instructions/PI as above. The native base-reward generation/cache initialization for every mill/garden/wheel subclass was not completely traced in this bounded pass, and must not be conflated with source42 doubling/replacement. No claim that instructions necessarily precede every native object constructor/cache fill.

questions.question: Is an exact physical script filename/mod order established?
questions.status: algorithm and phase ordering answered; concrete runtime mounted order unobserved
questions.answer: ERA LoadScriptsFromDisk first loads global libraries, internal map scripts, map-directory scripts, then selected global scripts and end libraries. GetOrderedPrioritizedFileList orders each directory group by descending numeric filename prefix after a case-insensitive name sort; earlier locations win duplicate names. A fixed script whitelist preserves its listed order. The actual VFS mounted file set, duplicate precedence and runtime config were not observed.

A script can explicitly invoke events/functions at arbitrary times; such reentrant or synthetic calls are outside the normal startup timeline.

Saved-game PO restoration, network/hotseat timing, campaign rollover, script reload and explicit manually fired events require separate runtime validation.
